records.invariant: Each descriptor boundary has a distinct name within its profile and each table cut maps to one window. Optional points report not-required; sites without points report unreached or undecided. A required row reports covered if at least one of its cuts was checked Pass and satisfies the ledger measurement rule, and gap otherwise. The census check names each gap and class. Every write accepted between scene install and that incarnation's Crash matches the boundary child at its position and block range; overflow anywhere in the retained capture since rebase fails the check. Bootstrap rebases the capture after the attach RESET root writes. Owner startup, session opens and the initial fixture key publication precede scene install. Range comparison starts strictly after these writes, at the next acceptance ordinal recorded at scene install. In a completed full-table run the final Crash snapshot closes the last comparison before the final recovered lookup. A step with no descriptor point and no device write is outside the census. The write-check control mutates the comparison.
